1.title: Man Who Attacked Ilhan Omar Sentenced to 14 Months After Plea Deal
1.summary: Anthony J. Kazmierczak sprayed vinegar at Ms. Omar while she was speaking at a Minneapolis town hall in January. He pleaded guilty to assault in May.

2.title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
2.summary: The BBC understands Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi are among the delegates allowed to enter the US.

3.title: Hasan Piker’s Comments Create Headaches for Abdul El-Sayed
3.summary: Under pressure, the Democratic Senate nominee in Michigan this week rejected Hasan Piker’s argument that the U.S. has caused more terror than Al Qaeda.

4.title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
4.summary: The BBC understands Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi are among the delegates allowed to enter the US.

5.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
5.summary: The US has not acknowledged carrying out February's deadly strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd.

6.title: U.S. Strike on Iranian School May Have Been War Crime, U.N. Report Says
6.summary: Mistakes that led to the deaths of more than a hundred children “went beyond negligence,” investigators said. They also cited a separate strike the same day that killed a reported 22 civilians.
